claim_scope.profile: guarded merge call with sha equal to reviewed head H0

effect_cut.definition: The point at which GitHub evaluates the supplied merge sha against the current pull-request head before permitting merge effect.
effect_cut.name: MERGE_SHA_PRECONDITION_EFFECT_CUT
effect_cut.post_review_transition: request_head_sha may change from H0 to H1 after review and before this cut.

claim_boundary.note: This commissioning case reproduces the v0.7 pinned external-evidence result. The product layer does not upgrade the core's model-relative claim.

display.declared_consequence: Merge the reviewed head; if the request-time head differs from the reviewed head, reject the stale request.
display.suggested_repair: Bind the merge effect to the reviewed head SHA, or perform an equivalent effect-time revalidation that rejects a changed head.
display.why_it_matters: A pull request can change after review but before the merge effect. Preserving the visible head is not enough if the effect path is not bound to the reviewed head.
